title: Hemoglobin–pulse coupling and circulating inflammation: an inconclusive cross-cycle prediction test
abstract: Hemoglobin-pulse coupling did not establish incremental prediction of log CRP across NHANES2007-2008 to2009-2010: weighted deltaMSE -0.002784, joint design-bootstrap95% [-0.009693,+0.006975]. Source n=4,725; independent-cycle target n=5,078. Nonlinear sex-specific standard physiological/CBC predictors were retained. Small point improvement was not robust to never-smoker and linear-comparator tests. Independently recruited cycles share the NHANES platform; repeated benchmark use precludes untouched confirmation. No biological novelty, causal mechanism, or clinical utility is established.
